第一百四十一章 觉醒妖神体（第1页）
觉醒妖神体（觉醒妖神体（第22页）又过了一日，百丈虚影彻底凝实。虚影缓缓握紧双拳，仰头发出一声震彻九霄的长啸。声浪如同滔天海啸，席卷百里群山。山峰周围栖息的低阶妖兽，连惨叫都来不及发出，便被恐怖的音波直接震碎，化为一团血雾。而那些高阶妖兽，皆是瑟瑟发抖，匍匐在地。一声长啸过后，百丈虚影渐渐虚化，最终消散于天地之间。崖壁石屋内，盘膝打坐的秦枫缓缓睁开双眼，感知到体内奔腾不息、浩瀚澎湃的气血之力，心中狂喜。他万万没有想到，仅仅一滴青龙精血，不仅让仙灵锻体功一举修炼至第四层大圆满，肉身达到破虚境巅峰，更是意外觉醒了上古妖神体。一旦催动妖神体，肉身力量将暴涨一倍有余，这般恐怖的提升，足以越阶碾压无数强者。秦枫想起血魔昔日所言，自己乃是万古独一的仙妖圣魔体。可为何炼化青龙精血，觉醒的却是妖神体。他心中暗自揣测，莫非这仙妖圣魔体，本就是仙、妖、魔三种至尊神体相互融合而成？需得逐一觉醒、逐一淬炼，待到三尊神体尽数觉醒圆满，方能相融归一，铸就独一无二的仙妖圣魔体。这些都只是他的个人猜测，单是获得一滴青龙精血，已是千载难逢的逆天造化，而仙之精血、魔神精血，只存在于古籍记载之中，又从何处能寻来此等神物。当然，这些都不是现在该想的问题。此刻秦枫心中只有一个念头，便是试一试，自己破虚境巅峰的肉身力量，究竟强横到何等地步。他抬手一招，地底蛰伏的金丝蛛破土而出，身躯急速蜷缩，化为一颗金色小球，被收入储物戒中。随即一步踏出，身影瞬息出现在虚空之上。他只是随意挥出一拳，金光自拳端喷涌而出，一只丈许大小的金色拳影，裹挟着万钧巨力撕裂长空，直击前方一座百丈石峰。一声惊天巨响，震彻方圆百里的山林，那些残存的高阶妖兽惊惶逃窜。坚硬的岩壁如同豆腐般被拳劲轻易洞穿，大小巨石四散崩飞，漫天岩尘飞扬。拳劲丝毫未衰，在石峰后方虚空拉出一道淡金色光痕，轰向第二座石峰。“轰”的一声巨响，第二座石峰自山腰处硬生生拦腰崩裂，上半截山峰失去支撑，轰隆一声倾斜坍塌，无数巨石滚落谷底，扬起漫天尘土。残存的拳劲一往无前，砸在远处第三座石峰之上。石峰岩壁瞬间被碾成齑粉，峰顶碎石顺着山壁滚落而下。三座矗立的石峰，被这随手一拳生生打穿。秦枫腾空俯瞰下方残破的三座石峰，心中惊叹自身力量的暴涨。方才的随手一拳，他仅仅动用了五成力道，可这一拳的威势，相较自己尚在破虚境初期之时，强横了足足五十倍有余，境界提升带来的力量增幅，已然远超同阶体修。

Chapter 141 Awakening of the Demon God Body (Page 1)
Awakening the Demon God Body (Awakening the Demon God Body (page 22)) Another day passed, and the hundred-foot shadow was completely solidified. The shadow slowly clenched its fists, raised its head and let out a long roar that shook the sky. The sound wave was like a tsunami, sweeping through the hundreds of miles of mountains. The low-level monsters living around the mountain peaks did not even have time to scream, and were directly shattered by the terrifying sound waves and turned into a mass of blood mist. And those high-level monsters were all rustling. Shivering, he lay prone on the ground. After a long roar, the shadow gradually faded and finally dissipated between the sky and the earth. In the stone house on the cliff, Qin Feng, who was sitting cross-legged and meditating, slowly opened his eyes and felt the energy flowing through his body. Breathing, the vast and surging power of blood, he was ecstatic in his heart. He never expected that just a drop of Qinglong's essence and blood would not only allow the immortal spirit to reach the fourth level of perfection in one fell swoop, but also reach the peak of the void-breaking realm. , and unexpectedly awakened the ancient demon god body. Once the demon god body is activated, the physical strength will more than double, and such a terrifying increase is enough to crush countless powerful people. Qin Feng remembered what the blood demon said in the past, but why was it the demon god body that was awakened after refining the blue dragon essence blood? The supreme divine bodies need to be awakened one by one and refined one by one. Only when the three divine bodies are fully awakened can they be merged and unified to create a unique immortal, demonic, holy and demonic body. These are just his personal guesses. Obtaining a drop of green dragon essence and blood is a once-in-a-lifetime feat. However, the essence and blood of immortals and demons only exist in ancient books, so where can such divine objects be found? Of course, these are not the questions that should be considered now. The only thought in Qin Feng's mind at this moment is to test how powerful his physical strength is at the peak of the Void Breaking Realm. He raised his hand, and the golden silk spider dormant in the ground burst out of the ground. His body quickly curled up and turned into a golden ball, which was stored in the storage ring. Then he stepped out, and his figure suddenly appeared in the void. After punching out, golden light spurted out from the tip of the fist, and a golden fist shadow about ten feet in size tore through the sky with huge force and hit a hundred-foot-high stone peak in front of him, causing a shocking sound that shook the entire radius. In the mountain forest, the remaining high-level monsters fled in panic. The hard rock wall was easily penetrated by the fist force like tofu, large and small boulders were scattered, and the rock dust was flying all over the sky. The fist force did not weaken at all. A trace of pale golden light was pulled out from the rear and struck the second stone peak. With a loud "boom", the second stone peak collapsed from the mountainside. The upper half of the mountain lost its support and collapsed with a roar. Countless boulders rolled down to the bottom of the valley, raising dust all over the sky. The remaining fist force rushed forward and smashed into the third stone peak in the distance. The rock wall of the stone peak was instantly crushed into powder, and the rocks on the top of the mountain were crushed along the mountain wall. Rolling down. The three standing stone peaks were punched through by this casual punch. Qin Feng looked down at the three broken stone peaks, and was amazed at the surge in his strength. He only used 50% of his strength in the casual punch, but the power of this punch was more than fifty times greater than when he was still in the early stage of the Shattering Void Realm. The increase in strength brought by the improvement of the realm has far exceeded that of the same level of physical cultivation.
